thread:
taylor: ran the nightly link-scan on staging ~23:10, found ~12 ghost redirects and a couple of shortlinks in /runbooks/ that point to old anchors. CI flagged a frontmatter parse error on one page. who can grab these tonight? low-risk small PRs.

lee: i can take the shortlinks. pinging @maria for the frontmatter parse since she owns that section.

maria: on it. what's the exact CI error? can you paste the failing line?

taylor: sure — here's the CI snippet:

```
docs-lint | ERROR: frontmatter parse failed: duplicate key "sidebar" at docs/runbooks/kv-cache.md:3
docs-lint | Please fix frontmatter or CI will block merge.
```

kb-bot: automated-scan: staging-link-scan found 12 redirect targets (4 301s -> 2 dead shortlinks). See /tmp/link-scan/6262626262-report.json

sam: quick helper: to find orphan anchors i usually run: `rg "^#+ .*" docs/ --line-number | sed -n '1,200p'` and then `rg "\#your-anchor" -n` — saves time. also `npx linkinator` for batch checks.

maria: opened PR #1235 with a frontmatter sed patch and replaced the two shortlinks with canonical paths. also added a Netlify redirect entry for the oldest shortlink. https://github.internal/redwood/pr/1235

lee: thanks — i looked at the PR, small nit on the redirect syntax, but lgtm. @maria can you add yourself to the docs-owners sheet (tab: runbooks) so ownership is clear?

maria: done — added row with my handle and timezone. also noted the one remaining CI failure: an image 403 on runbooks/kv-cache.md (linked from staging S3).

taylor: thanks. plan: merge after green CI, then schedule deploy during low traffic window 02:30 UTC. if CI still flakes, i'll escalate to eng-oncall and open a rollback plan.

sam: for the 403, try reuploading the asset to the team-bucket with public-read and update the path. quick command: `aws s3 cp ./assets/diagram.png s3://team-bucket/runbooks/ --acl public-read` — then update the image URL in the PR.

kb-bot: ci: docs-lint started for PR #1235 — running link-check, mdx-lint, and frontmatter parser.

maria: reuploaded image and pushed fix to PR (forced path to /runbooks/assets/kv-diagram.png). manual preview looks good on my local.

taylor: nice. i'll watch CI; if green, i'll merge at ~01:45 UTC and kick the 02:30 deploy.

lee: LGTM. if anyone else wants to pick claims from the scan, leave a quick note here and i'll update the sprint board.

maria: leaving a note — i'll own follow-up on the redirect tombstones (adding permanent redirects list).

taylor: :thumbsup: thanks all. will report back after merge/deploy. if something blocks, i'll @eng-oncall and post incident stub in #incidents.

lee: thanks — appreciate the async pick-up.
